submitted.rationale: Index 34 (Fe0.39 Ni0.18 V0.42), which has Fe:V close to 1:1 and low Ni, gave the highest measured photocurrent: 2.8e-6 A. Its XRD shows peaks from the SnO2/FTO substrate plus extra peaks at Q ≈ 1.93, 2.30 and 2.50, consistent with an FeVO4-like phase. That phase is a known visible-light photoanode.

rejected.reason: V-rich multiphase film (many extra XRD peaks); photocurrent was lower at 1.82e-6 A
Fe-rich film with hematite- or spinel-like peaks; lowest photocurrent at 7.9e-7 A
Ni-rich; XRD shows a mostly Ni-oxide film. Ni-rich oxides are expected to be poor photoanodes, so no merit measurement was spent on it
